note: RAW JSON pane of the admin window: the core's own server configs by name on the left, the file itself in an editor on the right, the Discord mirror switches under it -- one per mirrorable kind, generated -- and RELOAD/APPLY at the bottom. Created by OZ_VppMenu.OnCreate under OZ_VppRoot at [0, vpp.paneY]. Names RawList, RawEdit, MirrorStrip, RawHint, BtnRawReload and BtnRawApply are read by OZ_VppMenu.c.

frame.name: PaneRaw
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open tab's pane and hides the rest.

listbox.name: RawList
listbox.note: Only configs whose owner is the core: a glue mod's own file belongs to whoever draws it.

field.name: RawEdit
field.note: The whole file, as text. 19 lines is what the 336-unit box holds at the fixed 14-point field face.

frame.name: MirrorStrip
frame.note: Empty: OZ_VppMenu fills it with one oz_vpp_mirror_row per kind mirror_list reports, so no mod's kind name lives in this repository. Here stood a fixed pair of switches named after the PDA's chat and the factions' roles -- a server with a third mod's kind could not reach it, and a server without the factions was offered a switch for a kind it does not have.

label.name: RawHint
label.note: Empty: every answer of the config route lands here.
